title: Special Angles Review
text: The special angles are: 0°, 30°, 45°, 60°, 90°. We need to express 15° using these angles.

title: Finding the Difference
text:
Look for two special angles whose difference equals 15°:
- 45° - 30° = 15° (both are special angles)
- 60° - 45° = 15° (both are special angles too!)

Either combination works, but 45° - 30° is commonly used.

title: Confirm the Expression
text:
$$15° = 45° - 30°$$

We will use the compound angle formula for sin(A - B).
